title: Randi's million-dollar challenge was really a 30-year payout he judged himself

tellings.quote: regard to the amazing Randy M the payoff was not a million dollar M it was an investment that would pay you eventually

related.note: Both are about James Randi's paranormal challenge. The stored story claims the prize was really a 30-year payout that Randi judged himself, while this telling presents it as a straightforward cash prize that began at $10,000.

plain: The stage magician and skeptic James Randi famously offered a million dollars to anyone who could prove a paranormal power, but the prize was not really a million in cash: it was an investment that would pay out over about 30 years, and Randi judged the tests himself. Joe McMoneagle, a former Army psychic spy who practised remote viewing, the attempt to describe distant places with the mind, tells it this way. If so, the famous challenge was less than it seemed.
